title: Santa Susana Knolls HOA
lede: A volunteer, non-profit association of Knolls neighbors, founded in 1969.
schedule_text: The HOA meets on the first Tuesday of every other month: February, April, June, August, October and December. Every Knolls resident is welcome.
board_text: Board members are volunteers elected by HOA members for two-year terms. Email any board member with questions, ideas or concerns.
membership_text: HOA membership is open to all Knolls residents. Members vote in board elections, which are held at the April meeting. For current dues and how to join, email the Treasurer or come to a meeting.
board_does_text: The board runs the meetings, keeps the HOA's records and funds, shares news with residents, and represents the neighborhood with Ventura County.
